title: SearchOutput
description: Single-query JSON envelope emitted by `duckduckgo-search-cli` (v0.8.9). Hand-maintained from `src/types::SearchOutput`. The Rust type is the source of truth. Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize.

query.description: The query string that produced this envelope.

endpoint.description: Which DuckDuckGo endpoint was hit (html = html.duckduckgo.com, lite = lite.duckduckgo.com).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the search. Rust type is DateTime<Utc> (chrono serde); wire remains a JSON string.

region.description: Region code used for the search (e.g., 'us-en', 'br-pt').

pages_fetched.description: Number of DDG pages actually fetched (1..=5). For multi-page auto-pagination, may exceed 1.

error.description: Error code when the search failed. Absent on success.

message.description: Human-readable error message. Absent on success.

metadata.description: Execution metadata: latency, identity used, cascade level, zero-cause classification (v0.8.0+).

zero_cause.description: v0.8.0+: Causal classification of zero-result scenarios. Absent when quantidade_results > 0. `vertical-sem-results` added in v0.8.9 (GAP-WS-104): legitimate zero from the news vertical, exit 5.

next_action_suggestion.description: v0.8.0+: Human-readable hint for the next operator action. Absent when causa_zero is 'legitimo' or absent.

news.description: v0.9.8: News-vertical results. Default vertical is all, so this field is commonly present (may be empty array on news degradation). Opt out with --vertical web.

news_count.description: v0.9.8: Count of news-vertical results after dedupe/cap (--num). Present when news vertical runs (default all). Exit code considers web + news counts.
